messages.subject: Question on controlling legend
parts:
Hi, suppose I have following plot using ggplot plotting technique:


df1 <- data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rnorm(100),
Name=sample(LETTERS[1:4], 100, replace=T), MM=sample(c(1:10), 100,
replace=T))
df1
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df1) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, colour=Name, size=MM))


Here you see ggplot reports 2 legends 1st for "Name" attribute and 2nd
for "MM" attribute. Here I want to do following:
1. completely remove 2nd legend i.e. legend which displays the "MM"
attribute
2. rename the 1st legend as "My name", instead of "Name"

It would great to me if anyone guide me how I can do that

Thanks

messages.subject: RE: Question on controlling legend
parts:
Hi Bogaso,

You can control this kind of issues from the different scale functions,
Hope this helps,
fernadno

library(ggplot2)

df1 <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100), y = rnorm(100),
Name = sample(LETTERS[1:4], 100, replace = T),
MM = sample(c(1:10), 100, replace = T))
df1
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(df1) + geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Name, size = MM))

p + scale_size(legend = FALSE) + scale_colour_discrete(name = "Your name")
